annotations.title: Log a request Cobalt can't do yet

description: Records something the person asked for that Cobalt Capture can't do yet, for the team that builds it. It changes nothing in Cobalt. Returns a sentence for the person saying it was logged, which is not a promise that it will be built. Not built yet: deleting a Cobalt account (today the person contacts support); cancelling, resuming or changing Pro (the person does it in the billing portal); replying to a comment on a review (comments can be listed, resolved and reopened); a review's display settings: numbered items, the table of contents, turning comments on or off, and changing the product link after the review is created; rendering a page behind a login or on a local or private address (the client can capture it and upload the image instead); video or screen recordings; private, password-protected or expiring review links; creating or revoking a review's agent token (done on the review page); multi-line or wrapped text labels on a screenshot; sending a review to Linear, Jira, Slack or other tools (GitHub issues are supported).

reason.description: Why Cobalt can't do it today.

request.description: What the person wanted, in their words where possible.

review.description: The review it was for, if any (URL or slug).

name: report_unmet_request
